capabilities: apply per-note page classes for state, atmosphere, note type, width and accent
insert callouts, highlights and image layout tokens in the editor
change the task state on the cursor line
preview each choice with the active theme before applying it
run the nine actions via commands, ribbon, context menu or an optional toolbar
disambiguation: Not a theme itself; it only applies the page classes and content styles supplied by the Cyriform theme.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; tested on Obsidian 1.13.7 on macOS with mobile support as a stated acceptance target. All features are free and local; applied classes remain in notes if the plugin is disabled.
problem: Applying the Cyriform theme's per-note cssclasses, callouts, highlights, task states and image tokens requires manually writing frontmatter classes and syntax; this provides searchable, keyboard-accessible pickers with previews.

relations.evidence: Cyriform Companion works with the Cyriform theme, which supplies the appearance of its per-note classes

summary: Companion plugin for the Cyriform theme that applies per-note page classes and inserts theme-styled callouts, highlights, task states and image layouts via visual pickers.
